title: Line items
description: What is billed, one item per element, in the order printed.

description.title: Description
description.description: What the item is, as the customer should read it.

quantity.title: Quantity
quantity.description: How many units are billed; fractions are allowed, such as 1.5 hours.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: What one unit is, such as hours or pcs. Printed after the quantity.

unit_price.title: Unit price
unit_price.description: The price of one unit in the invoice's currency, to the cent. A negative price is a discount or credit.
